_doc: The 7 codified review lenses that replace the 14 design-room personas (a deliberate cut from an earlier multi-persona-debate design — see README). A lens may ONLY emit one of: a cited-principle check, a forced-choice fork for the founder, a fact-check against grounding, or a hand-off to the reactive anti-AI gate. A lens may NEVER originate a token/color/font/copy line, and NEVER resolve its own fork. verify_design_room.py asserts the live SKILL.md references every lens id and carries no persona-debate language.

source_values.cited: emits 'principle X (canon) implies testable rule Y; the page does/doesn't' — must list canon_refs
source_values.fork: emits a forced-choice the FOUNDER resolves; the lens never picks
source_values.grounded: emits a fact-check of the page against grounding/ tokens; never invents the fact
source_values.gate: hands off to the reactive anti-AI gate (eyeball + impeccable); originates nothing

lenses.name: First-impression / scan
lenses.emits: Whether the page survives a 50ms / first-3-second scan: is the primary action and the what-is-this reachable on the F or Z path in the first screen.
lenses.may_not: originate the layout; decide what the primary action should be

lenses.name: Conversion & usability
lenses.emits: Whether interaction cost is minimised: target sizes (Fitts), choice count (Hick), self-evidence (Krug), heuristic violations (Nielsen).
lenses.may_not: originate copy; assert a conversion number without a canon citation

lenses.name: Decision psychology
lenses.emits: Whether the page lets a stressed buyer recognise their situation and act, and whether perceived polish is buying trust it must then honour (aesthetic-usability).
lenses.may_not: name the buyer's pain for them; originate the emotional framing

lenses.name: Positioning / retell
lenses.emits: A forced-choice: of N candidate one-sentence retells (each drawn from grounding/positioning), which is the page's spine? Founder picks.
lenses.may_not: pick the retell; write a new positioning the founder did not supply

lenses.name: Technical accuracy
lenses.emits: A fact-check: every technical claim, code sample, tool screenshot on the page matches a grounding source; flags any that don't.
lenses.may_not: invent the correct value; pass a claim with no grounding source

lenses.name: Visual boldness vs feasibility
lenses.emits: A forced-choice per section: salience/boldness (Von Restorff: the ONE thing that breaks the pattern) vs scan-speed + performance budget (LCP < 2.5s). Founder picks where to spend boldness.
lenses.may_not: pick the bold element; choose the palette or font itself

lenses.name: Anti-slop / specificity
lenses.emits: Hand-off to the reactive anti-AI gate (eyeball scan + impeccable detectors): generic copy, convergent fonts, gradient-text, emoji icons, 'describe the situation, do not name the feeling'.
lenses.may_not: originate copy; act as a fork — it is a gate, not a chooser
